core_obligations: Identify the space: the residual space of the point is the underlying space of the residual gerbe, which by construction is the closure of the point (proof lines 10855-10862)
Reduce to a presentation: closedness of that subset is tested after a smooth presentation, where it becomes the closure of a point of a scheme (proof lines 10863-10868)
Conclude: the closure of a point of a scheme is closed, so the residual space is closed in the space of the stack (proof lines 10869-10870)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the residual space of a point of an algebraic stack is a closed subset of the space of the stack (author lemma at source lines 10846-10854, label lemma-residual-space-closed). The proof (source lines 10856-10871) identifies the residual space with the closure of the point, reduces closedness to a presentation and applies the corresponding statement for schemes (proof lines 10856-10870).
